title: HP TET TGT Arts · September 2018 (previous year questions)
description: Questions asked in the HP TET TGT (Arts) exam held on 8 September 2018, with answers checked against a published solved paper and independently verified. Not the complete paper.

questions.text: What are the mean and standard deviation of 6, 7, 8, 9 and 2 respectively?
questions.explanation: Mean = 32/5 = 6.4; the variance is 29.2/5 = 5.84, so the standard deviation is about 2.42 (≈ 2.43). (Q1 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/02/hp-tet-arts-2018-solved-paper-part-1.html
questions.textHi: 6, 7, 8, 9 और 2 का माध्य और मानक विचलन क्रमशः क्या है?

questions.text: Which of the following fields is not covered in co-scholastic evaluation?
questions.explanation: Co-scholastic evaluation covers life skills, attitudes, values, health and activities; academic subjects fall under scholastic evaluation. (Q2 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/02/hp-tet-arts-2018-solved-paper-part-1.html
questions.textHi: सह-शैक्षिक (को-स्कॉलैस्टिक) मूल्यांकन में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा क्षेत्र शामिल नहीं होता?
questions.explanationHi: सह-शैक्षिक मूल्यांकन में जीवन कौशल, अभिवृत्तियाँ, मूल्य, स्वास्थ्य और गतिविधियाँ आती हैं; अकादमिक विषय शैक्षिक (स्कॉलैस्टिक) मूल्यांकन में आते हैं।

questions.text: Evaluation is:
questions.explanation: Evaluation includes both quantitative description (measurement) and qualitative description, plus value judgement. (Q3 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/02/hp-tet-arts-2018-solved-paper-part-1.html
questions.textHi: मूल्यांकन होता है:
questions.explanationHi: मूल्यांकन में मात्रात्मक (मापन) और गुणात्मक दोनों प्रकार का वर्णन तथा मूल्य-निर्णय शामिल होता है।

questions.text: The proverb "Grapes are sour" is related to:
questions.explanation: 'Sour grapes' is the classic example of rationalization — giving a plausible excuse for failing to get something. (Q4 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/02/hp-tet-arts-2018-solved-paper-part-1.html
questions.textHi: "अंगूर खट्टे हैं" कहावत किससे संबंधित है?
questions.explanationHi: 'अंगूर खट्टे हैं' युक्तिकरण का प्रसिद्ध उदाहरण है — असफलता के लिए तर्कसंगत लगने वाला बहाना बनाना।

questions.text: The place of school in the socialization of a child is:
questions.explanation: The family is the primary agency of socialization; the school comes next as the most important secondary agency. (Q6 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/02/hp-tet-arts-2018-solved-paper-part-1.html
questions.textHi: बालक के समाजीकरण में विद्यालय का स्थान है:
questions.explanationHi: परिवार समाजीकरण की प्राथमिक संस्था है; उसके बाद विद्यालय सबसे महत्वपूर्ण द्वितीयक संस्था है।

questions.text: Intelligence and creativity are:
questions.explanation: Research (e.g. Getzels and Jackson) shows a positive, though moderate, correlation between intelligence and creativity. (Q8 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/02/hp-tet-arts-2018-solved-paper-part-1.html
questions.textHi: बुद्धि और सृजनात्मकता:
questions.explanationHi: शोध (जैसे गेट्जेल्स और जैक्सन) बताते हैं कि बुद्धि और सृजनात्मकता में धनात्मक, यद्यपि मध्यम, सहसंबंध होता है।

questions.text: What is meant by social environment?
questions.explanation: The social environment includes all the people a child interacts with — family, relatives, teachers and society. (Q9 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/02/hp-tet-arts-2018-solved-paper-part-1.html
questions.textHi: सामाजिक पर्यावरण से क्या अभिप्राय है?
questions.explanationHi: सामाजिक पर्यावरण में वे सभी लोग आते हैं जिनसे बालक का संपर्क होता है — परिवार, संबंधी, शिक्षक और समाज।

questions.text: Who propounded the theory of "Trial and Error"?
questions.explanation: E. L. Thorndike propounded trial-and-error learning from his puzzle-box experiments with cats. (Q10 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/02/hp-tet-arts-2018-solved-paper-part-1.html
questions.textHi: "प्रयास और त्रुटि" का सिद्धांत किसने प्रतिपादित किया?
questions.explanationHi: ई. एल. थॉर्नडाइक ने बिल्लियों पर पज़ल-बॉक्स प्रयोगों से प्रयास और त्रुटि का सिद्धांत दिया।

questions.text: As the infant grows, his mental ability:
questions.explanation: Mental ability increases with age through childhood and adolescence as the child matures. (Q12 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/02/hp-tet-arts-2018-solved-paper-part-2.html
questions.textHi: जैसे-जैसे शिशु बड़ा होता है, उसकी मानसिक योग्यता:
questions.explanationHi: परिपक्वता के साथ बाल्यावस्था और किशोरावस्था में मानसिक योग्यता आयु के साथ बढ़ती है।

questions.text: Hollingworth is associated with her work on:
questions.explanation: Leta Hollingworth is known for her pioneering studies of gifted children. (Q14 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/02/hp-tet-arts-2018-solved-paper-part-2.html
questions.textHi: हॉलिंगवर्थ का कार्य किससे संबंधित है?
questions.explanationHi: लेटा हॉलिंगवर्थ प्रतिभाशाली बालकों पर अपने अग्रणी अध्ययनों के लिए जानी जाती हैं।

questions.text: According to Piaget, the sensorimotor stage includes which age group?
questions.explanation: Piaget's sensorimotor stage lasts from birth to about 2 years. (Q15 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/02/hp-tet-arts-2018-solved-paper-part-2.html
questions.textHi: पियाजे के अनुसार संवेदी-गामक (इन्द्रियजनित गामक) अवस्था में कौन-सा आयु वर्ग आता है?
questions.explanationHi: पियाजे की संवेदी-गामक अवस्था जन्म से लगभग 2 वर्ष तक रहती है।

questions.text: Later childhood is also known as:
questions.explanation: Later childhood (about 6–12 years) is called the 'gang age' because children love to form peer groups. (Q16 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/02/hp-tet-arts-2018-solved-paper-part-2.html
questions.textHi: उत्तर बाल्यावस्था को और किस नाम से जाना जाता है?
questions.explanationHi: उत्तर बाल्यावस्था (लगभग 6–12 वर्ष) को 'टोली आयु' कहते हैं क्योंकि इसमें बच्चे साथियों के समूह बनाना पसंद करते हैं।

questions.text: The term "mental hygiene" was given by:
questions.explanation: William Sweetser coined the term 'mental hygiene' (1843); Clifford Beers later led the mental hygiene movement. (Q17 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/02/hp-tet-arts-2018-solved-paper-part-2.html
questions.textHi: "मानसिक स्वास्थ्य विज्ञान" (मेंटल हाइजीन) शब्द किसने दिया?
questions.explanationHi: विलियम स्वीट्जर ने 1843 में 'मेंटल हाइजीन' शब्द दिया; बाद में क्लिफर्ड बियर्स ने मानसिक स्वास्थ्य आंदोलन चलाया।

questions.text: Who is the father of behaviourism?
questions.explanation: John B. Watson founded behaviourism with his 1913 manifesto. (Q18 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/02/hp-tet-arts-2018-solved-paper-part-2.html
questions.textHi: व्यवहारवाद का जनक कौन है?
questions.explanationHi: जॉन बी. वॉटसन ने 1913 में व्यवहारवाद की स्थापना की।

questions.text: The formula for calculating intelligence quotient (IQ) is:
questions.explanation: IQ = (Mental Age ÷ Chronological Age) × 100. (Q20 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/02/hp-tet-arts-2018-solved-paper-part-2.html
questions.textHi: बुद्धि-लब्धि (IQ) ज्ञात करने का सूत्र है:
questions.explanationHi: बुद्धि-लब्धि = (मानसिक आयु ÷ वास्तविक आयु) × 100।

questions.text: According to Piaget, egocentrism is:
options: A child thinks he is the centre of the world and everything revolves around him
Environment is the centre of knowledge
questions.explanation: Egocentrism is the child's inability to see things from any viewpoint other than his own, as if the world revolves around him. (Q21 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/02/hp-tet-arts-2018-solved-paper-part-3.html
questions.textHi: पियाजे के अनुसार आत्मकेंद्रिता (अहंकेंद्रिता) है:
optionsHi: बालक स्वयं को संसार का केंद्र समझता है और सब कुछ उसी के चारों ओर घूमता है
questions.explanationHi: आत्मकेंद्रिता में बालक दूसरों के दृष्टिकोण से चीज़ों को नहीं देख पाता, मानो संसार उसी के चारों ओर घूमता हो।

questions.text: The concrete operational stage of cognitive development ranges from:
questions.explanation: Piaget's concrete operational stage is roughly 7 to 11 years. (Q22 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/02/hp-tet-arts-2018-solved-paper-part-3.html
questions.textHi: संज्ञानात्मक विकास की मूर्त संक्रियात्मक अवस्था की आयु सीमा है:
questions.explanationHi: पियाजे की मूर्त संक्रियात्मक अवस्था लगभग 7 से 11 वर्ष तक होती है।

questions.text: Which of the following methods helps to study children with special needs?
questions.explanation: The case study method gives an in-depth study of an individual child, which suits children with special needs. (Q23 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/02/hp-tet-arts-2018-solved-paper-part-3.html
questions.textHi: विशेष आवश्यकता वाले बालकों के अध्ययन में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी विधि सहायक है?
questions.explanationHi: व्यक्ति अध्ययन विधि से किसी एक बालक का गहन अध्ययन होता है, जो विशेष आवश्यकता वाले बालकों के लिए उपयुक्त है।

questions.text: Who said, "Heredity is the sum total of inborn individual traits"?
questions.explanation: This definition of heredity is attributed to B. N. Jha in Indian educational psychology texts. (Q24 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/02/hp-tet-arts-2018-solved-paper-part-3.html
questions.textHi: "वंशानुक्रम जन्मजात व्यक्तिगत विशेषताओं का पूर्ण योग है" — यह किसने कहा?
questions.explanationHi: वंशानुक्रम की यह परिभाषा बी. एन. झा की मानी जाती है।

questions.text: Children whose mental age is lower than their chronological age are called:
questions.explanation: When mental age is below chronological age (IQ well below 100), the child is classed as mentally retarded (now: intellectually disabled). (Q25 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/02/hp-tet-arts-2018-solved-paper-part-3.html
questions.textHi: जिन बालकों की मानसिक आयु उनकी वास्तविक आयु से कम होती है, उन्हें कहते हैं:
questions.explanationHi: जब मानसिक आयु वास्तविक आयु से कम होती है तो बालक को मंदबुद्धि (बौद्धिक अक्षमता वाला) कहा जाता है।

questions.text: Which one of these is not a measure of central tendency?
questions.explanation: Mean, median and mode are measures of central tendency; standard deviation is a measure of dispersion. (Q27 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/02/hp-tet-arts-2018-solved-paper-part-3.html
questions.textHi: इनमें से कौन-सा केंद्रीय प्रवृत्ति का माप नहीं है?
questions.explanationHi: माध्य, माध्यिका और बहुलक केंद्रीय प्रवृत्ति के माप हैं; मानक विचलन विचलनशीलता (प्रसार) का माप है।

questions.text: The school of behaviourism focuses on studying:
questions.explanation: Behaviourism studies only observable (overt) behaviour and rejects the study of inner mental states. (Q29 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/02/hp-tet-arts-2018-solved-paper-part-3.html
questions.textHi: व्यवहारवादी संप्रदाय किसके अध्ययन पर बल देता है?
questions.explanationHi: व्यवहारवाद केवल अवलोकनीय (प्रकट) व्यवहार का अध्ययन करता है और आंतरिक मानसिक अवस्थाओं को अस्वीकार करता है।

questions.text: Which of the following is affected most by extreme scores?
questions.explanation: The arithmetic mean uses every value, so extreme scores pull it the most; median and mode are resistant. (Q30 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/02/hp-tet-arts-2018-solved-paper-part-3.html
questions.textHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन चरम (अति) प्राप्तांकों से सर्वाधिक प्रभावित होता है?
questions.explanationHi: समांतर माध्य में सभी मानों का प्रयोग होता है, इसलिए चरम मान उसे सबसे अधिक प्रभावित करते हैं।

questions.text: Give one word for the expression: Matter written by hand
questions.explanation: A manuscript is a document written by hand. (Q31 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/02/hp-tet-arts-2018-solved-paper-part-4.html

questions.text: Give one word for the expression: Study of the art of teaching
questions.explanation: Pedagogy is the method and practice (art and science) of teaching. (Q32 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/02/hp-tet-arts-2018-solved-paper-part-4.html

questions.text: The correct masculine gender for 'doe' is:
questions.explanation: Doe (female deer/rabbit) — buck is the male. (Q34 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/02/hp-tet-arts-2018-solved-paper-part-4.html

questions.text: Choose the correct indirect speech: He said to me, "Do you know me?"
options: He asked me if I knew him
He said to me if I know him
He said if I knew him
He asked if I had known him
questions.explanation: A yes/no question becomes 'asked + if', with the present tense shifted to past: 'He asked me if I knew him.' (Q35 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/02/hp-tet-arts-2018-solved-paper-part-4.html

questions.text: Choose the correct indirect speech: He said, "Let us take him to the doctor."
options: He said let them take him to the doctor
He suggested that they should take him to the doctor
He said that doctor should be called
questions.explanation: 'Let us' expressing a proposal is reported with 'suggested that ... should'. (Q36 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/02/hp-tet-arts-2018-solved-paper-part-4.html

questions.text: Choose the correct option to complete the sentence: Please tell me ______.
questions.explanation: In an embedded (indirect) question the word order is subject + verb: 'where the bus stop is'. (Q37 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/02/hp-tet-arts-2018-solved-paper-part-4.html

questions.text: Choose the correct question tag: You are a bit late today, ______
questions.explanation: A positive statement with 'are' takes the negative tag 'aren't you?'. (Q38 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/02/hp-tet-arts-2018-solved-paper-part-4.html

questions.text: Complete the proverb: As you sow, ______.
questions.explanation: The proverb is 'As you sow, so shall you reap.' (Q41 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/02/hp-tet-arts-2018-solved-paper-part-5.html

questions.text: Complete the proverb: Rome ______ in a day.
questions.explanation: The proverb is 'Rome was not built in a day.' (Q42 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/02/hp-tet-arts-2018-solved-paper-part-5.html

questions.text: Choose the correct preposition: The cat slept on the bed ______ the little boy.
questions.explanation: 'Beside' means next to; 'besides' means in addition to. (Q43 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/02/hp-tet-arts-2018-solved-paper-part-5.html

questions.text: Choose the correct preposition: The toddler fell ______ the chair.
questions.explanation: 'Fell off the chair' — 'off' shows movement away from a surface. (Q44 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/02/hp-tet-arts-2018-solved-paper-part-5.html

questions.text: Change the following simple sentence to complex: I do not know the time of her arrival.
options: I do not know when he will come
I do not know about her arrival
questions.explanation: The correct complex sentence is 'I do not know when she will arrive'; option A changes 'her' to 'he', so none of the given options is right. (Q45 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/02/hp-tet-arts-2018-solved-paper-part-5.html

questions.text: Change the following compound sentence to a simple sentence: He finished his work and went to play.
options: He finished his work and then played
Having finished his work, he went to play
questions.explanation: A participle phrase ('Having finished his work') turns the compound sentence into a simple one. (Q46 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/02/hp-tet-arts-2018-solved-paper-part-5.html

questions.text: Choose the correct conjunction: You must work ______ starve.
questions.explanation: 'Or' gives the alternative: work or (else) starve. (Q47 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/02/hp-tet-arts-2018-solved-paper-part-5.html

questions.text: Choose the correct conjunction: Many things have happened ______ I left school.
questions.explanation: 'Since' marks the point in time from which something has continued (present perfect). (Q48 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/02/hp-tet-arts-2018-solved-paper-part-5.html

questions.text: Choose the appropriate conjunction: I went swimming ______ it was cold.
questions.explanation: 'Although' shows contrast: I swam in spite of the cold. (Q52 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/02/hp-tet-arts-2018-solved-paper-part-6.html

questions.text: Choose the appropriate conjunction: Neera must study hard ______ she will fail.
questions.explanation: 'Or' means 'otherwise' here: study hard, or she will fail. (Q53 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/02/hp-tet-arts-2018-solved-paper-part-6.html

questions.text: Choose the appropriate conjunction: Dinner was ready ______ we sat down to eat.
questions.explanation: 'So' introduces the result: dinner was ready, so we sat down to eat. (Q54 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/02/hp-tet-arts-2018-solved-paper-part-6.html

questions.text: Choose the antonym of the word in capitals: MISER
questions.explanation: A miser hoards money; a spendthrift spends it wastefully. (Q55 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/02/hp-tet-arts-2018-solved-paper-part-6.html

questions.text: Choose the antonym of the word in capitals: FLOAT
questions.explanation: The opposite of float is sink. (Q56 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/02/hp-tet-arts-2018-solved-paper-part-6.html

questions.text: Choose the correct indirect speech: He said, "Be quiet and listen to my words."
options: He ordered them to be quiet
He told them to be quiet and listen to my words
He urged them to be quiet and listen to his words
He said be quiet and listen to my words
questions.explanation: An imperative is reported with a reporting verb + infinitive, and 'my' changes to 'his'; only option C keeps the whole sentence with the correct pronoun. (Q57 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/02/hp-tet-arts-2018-solved-paper-part-6.html

questions.text: Who was the first Chief Justice of the High Court of Himachal Pradesh?
questions.explanation: Justice M. H. Beg became the first Chief Justice of the H.P. High Court in 1971 (he later became Chief Justice of India). (Q61 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/02/hp-tet-arts-2018-solved-paper-part-7.html
questions.textHi: हिमाचल प्रदेश उच्च न्यायालय के पहले मुख्य न्यायाधीश कौन थे?
questions.explanationHi: न्यायमूर्ति एम. एच. बेग 1971 में हिमाचल प्रदेश उच्च न्यायालय के पहले मुख्य न्यायाधीश बने (बाद में वे भारत के मुख्य न्यायाधीश बने)।

questions.text: 'Indira Point' is situated in:
questions.explanation: Indira Point, India's southernmost point, is on Great Nicobar Island. (Q62 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/02/hp-tet-arts-2018-solved-paper-part-7.html
questions.textHi: 'इंदिरा पॉइंट' कहाँ स्थित है?

questions.explanation: Australia is in the Southern Hemisphere, so December falls in summer. (Q145 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/02/hp-tet-arts-2018-solved-paper-part-15.html
questions.textHi: क्रिसमस का त्योहार गर्मियों में कहाँ मनाया जाता है?
questions.explanationHi: ऑस्ट्रेलिया दक्षिणी गोलार्ध में है, इसलिए वहाँ दिसंबर में गर्मी होती है।

questions.text: When did the partition of Bengal take place?
questions.explanation: Lord Curzon partitioned Bengal in 1905. (Q146 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/02/hp-tet-arts-2018-solved-paper-part-15.html
questions.textHi: बंगाल का विभाजन कब हुआ?
questions.explanationHi: लॉर्ड कर्ज़न ने 1905 में बंगाल का विभाजन किया।

questions.text: The Ghadar Party was organised by:
questions.explanation: Lala Har Dayal founded the Ghadar Party in San Francisco in 1913. (Q147 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/02/hp-tet-arts-2018-solved-paper-part-15.html
questions.textHi: ग़दर पार्टी का गठन किसने किया?
questions.explanationHi: लाला हरदयाल ने 1913 में सैन फ्रांसिस्को में ग़दर पार्टी की स्थापना की।

questions.text: Who introduced the Doctrine of Lapse?
questions.explanation: Lord Dalhousie applied the Doctrine of Lapse (1848–56). (Q148 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/02/hp-tet-arts-2018-solved-paper-part-15.html
questions.textHi: व्यपगत का सिद्धांत (डॉक्ट्रिन ऑफ लैप्स) किसने लागू किया?
questions.explanationHi: लॉर्ड डलहौज़ी ने व्यपगत का सिद्धांत (1848–56) लागू किया।

questions.text: Where is the headquarters of the U.N.O.?
questions.explanation: The UN headquarters is in New York. (Q149 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/02/hp-tet-arts-2018-solved-paper-part-15.html
questions.textHi: संयुक्त राष्ट्र संघ का मुख्यालय कहाँ है?
questions.explanationHi: संयुक्त राष्ट्र का मुख्यालय न्यूयॉर्क में है।

questions.text: Who built the Red Fort of Agra?
questions.explanation: Akbar built the Agra Fort (1565–73); Shah Jahan built the Red Fort of Delhi. (Q150 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/02/hp-tet-arts-2018-solved-paper-part-15.html
questions.textHi: आगरा का लाल किला किसने बनवाया?
questions.explanationHi: अकबर ने आगरा का किला (1565–73) बनवाया; दिल्ली का लाल किला शाहजहाँ ने बनवाया।
